subject.title: auth.order ignored for GitHub Copilot provider — first profile in auth.profiles always wins

question: Should maintainers adopt the open conflicting fork fix candidate for this Copilot `auth.order` bug, or close it and queue a narrow in-repo replacement?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the issue already has an open conflicting fork PR with closing syntax plus `no-new-fix-pr` and maintainer-review labels, so automation should not create a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Review the linked fork PR first
options.body: Evaluate `https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/898`, then either repair/adopt it or close it before dispatching replacement work.

options.title: Close the fork and queue replacement
options.body: If the fork branch is not worth adopting, close it with rationale and let a narrow in-repo fix target the Copilot plugin auth-order path.

options.title: Defer the fix
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical bug while leaving the current first-profile behavior in place for now.

recommendation.title: Review the linked fork PR first
recommendation.body: Evaluate `https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/898`, then either repair/adopt it or close it before dispatching replacement work.

likelyOwner.reason: The current behavior sits on the bundled provider plugin/auth boundary that Peter Steinberger most directly shaped in recent history.
